# `company.invoice_batch_results`

One customer of one batch run: the invoice it created, or the error that refused it.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | ix_invoice_batch_results_customer | — | Stable ULID of this per-customer outcome. |
| `batch_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with batch_id + customer_id, unique with batch_id + position | — | invoice_batches.id | Batch run this outcome belongs to. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with batch_id + position | — | — | Order this customer was invoiced in, from 1. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with batch_id + customer_id | ix_invoice_batch_results_customer | customers.id | Customer or job this outcome is for. |
| `customer_label` | VARCHAR(1004) | no | — | — | — | — | Full name of the customer at the time of the run. |
| `status` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Outcome for this customer: created or failed. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | transactions.id | Invoice created for this customer; null when the customer failed. |
| `number` | VARCHAR(64) | yes | — | — | — | — | Document number allocated to the created invoice; null when the customer failed. |
| `total_minor_units` | BIGINT | yes | — | — | — | — | Resolved gross total of the created invoice; null when the customer failed. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | yes | — | — | — | — | Currency of the created total; null when the customer failed. |
| `error_code` | VARCHAR(64) | yes | — | — | — | — | Stable error code the refused invoice raised; null when the customer succeeded. |

| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this batch outcome was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this batch outcome. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this batch outcome. |
